summary: Reads are slow after the bounds check landed
description: Since the bounds check was added to Store.read the read benchmark takes about 12 percent more time. Profiling shows the extra time is spent inside checkBounds, which is called on every read. The per-call cost is tiny but the call count is 50000.

summary: Add a --verbose flag to the exporter
description: It would be useful to see what the exporter is doing. Add a --verbose flag that prints each record as it is written.

summary: Out-of-bounds read in the record decoder
description: A crafted record makes Decoder.decode read past the end of the buffer. CVE-2026-0001. A crash input from oss-fuzz is attached as a reproducer.
The README says 'recieve'. It should say 'receive'.

summary: Cache misses cause repeated fetches from the store
description: When the cache misses we go to the store every single time, so a cold start does the same expensive fetch again and again. Memory usage also climbs because nothing is evicted.
